prompt: I'm the executor on task t7. The reviewer rejected my first fix, which retried the upload, because a retry can double-post. I made the upload idempotent instead, and tests/run.sh passes at commit abc1234. Write the review note I should submit for t7 and show it to me before you send anything.
note: Behavioral outcome UNMEASURED: no model run was made. A natural request (no slash command) to write a review note after a consequential choice. The agent should load the scheduler guidance and show a note that carries the concrete choice (idempotent upload), its reason (a retry can double-post), the evidence pointer (commit abc1234) and the observed result (the tests pass), without submitting it. The regexes grade that content, not literal field labels. Limits: the same facts are in the prompt, so the regexes alone do not separate a guided note from an echo; the guidance-loaded check carries that. Order, quality and the single-line shape are not graded. The agent is told not to send: forbidden_scripts fails the case on any attempt to run task-review.sh, including a failed one; a literal cat of the helper source is allowed. The helper is therefore not exercised; fail-closed behavior is covered by scheduler-task-new-positive.
